Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable
public class Game extends Object implements Observable

Represents a game instance, managing the game state, players, board, and game progression. The game follows a state machine pattern, where the current state determines the allowed actions and transitions.

This class also works as an interface between the Model, of which it is the most important piece, and the Controller. It implements the Observable interface, allowing observers (e.g., network components) to be notified of game events.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int numPlayers, int gameId)

      Creates a new game with the specified number of players and game ID. The game starts in the WaitingRoomState state, with an empty list of players, the current player index set to 0, the current round and age set to 1, and a new Board instance initialized for the specified number of players.

      Parameters:
      numPlayers - between 2 and 5
      gameId - unique identifier for this game instance, provided by the LobbyController.

    • Game

      public Game(GameState lastCurrentState, List<Player> lastPlayers, Board lastBoard, int lastCurrentPlayerIndex, int numPlayers, int currentRound, int currentAge, int gameId)

      Creates a new game instance from the provided parameters, typically used for restoring a game after a server crash or shutdown. The game state is initialized to WaitingRoomAfterCrashState, and the previously saved state is set to the provided last current state.

      Parameters:
      lastCurrentState - the last saved state of the game before the crash
      lastPlayers - the list of players in the game before the crash
      lastBoard - the game board state before the crash
      lastCurrentPlayerIndex - the index of the current player before the crash
      numPlayers - the total number of players in the game
      currentRound - the current round of the game before the crash
      currentAge - the current age of the game before the crash
      gameId - unique identifier for this game instance.

    • pickCard

      public void pickCard(String nickname, int cardId, int row) throws WrongStateException, WrongTurnException, IllegalPickException, ForcedPickException, UnknownNicknameException, SQLException

      performs the pick card action given the current state of the game.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player picking the card
      cardId - the id of the card to be picked
      row - the row from which to pick, between 0 and 3
      Throws:
      WrongStateException - if this.currentState.pickCard() throws it
      WrongTurnException - if this.currentState.pickCard() throws it
      IllegalPickException - if this.currentState.pickCard() throws it or card not found
      ForcedPickException - if this.currentState.pickCard() throws it
      UnknownNicknameException - if the nickname is not found
      SQLException
